module: Central registry of the player's career attributes: money, beamXP, vouchers, one attribute per branch/skill (branch.attributeKey) and <orgId>Reputation per organization. Each attribute has a value, cumulative gains and losses per tag (+ "all"), and optionally min/max. Every change goes through addAttributes (or setAttributes), which updates the statistics, keeps the change log, writes to career_modules_log and emits the onPlayerAttributesChanged(change, reason) hook. Saved to career/playerAttributes.json and career/attributeLog.json.
notes: reason = {label, tags}. label is a translation key or a table {txt, context}; tags is a list converted into a dictionary. Without reason, a warning is logged with the call stack.
Tags are used by milestones: money.gains/losses[tag] feed career_modules_milestones_generalMilestones_money (reward, buying, selling, delivery, fine, partsBought, vehicleBought).
A change to an attribute ending in "Reputation" calls career_career.interactWithOrganization(orgId).
Values are bounded by attribute.min/max (reputation: -50 to 700).
Gameplay tag with money (outside the tutorial) unlocks the FIRST_ASSIGNMENT achievement; fine tag with money unlocks PAID_THE_PRICE.
Bug: M.logAttributeChange = logAttributeChange references an undefined variable: the exported field is nil.

init() (not exported) is called only by onExtensionLoaded when attributes is nil; the career's starting mode may provide initPlayerAttributes(M), otherwise the starting money is 10000 (label startingCapital).
Compatibility: bonusStars becomes vouchers if the save version is < 37; old branch names are remapped via career_branches.oldAttributeNamesToNewNames.

logAttributeChange.desc: Always nil: references a local variable that does not exist in the file (bug).

addAttributes.desc: Adds the given changes to the attributes (creating them if absent), updates gains/losses per tag, records the entry in attributeLog, writes a career log and emits onPlayerAttributesChanged(change, reason).

change.desc: Change per attribute (positive = gain, negative = loss).

reason.desc: Reason: label and list of tags.

setAttributes.desc: Sets absolute values by calling addAttributes with the difference from the current value.

getAttribute.desc: Returns the full object of an attribute {value, gains, losses, min, max}.

returns.desc: Attribute, nil if it does not exist.

getAttributeValue.desc: Returns the numeric value of an attribute (0 if it does not exist).

getAllAttributes.desc: Returns the table of all attributes (direct reference, not copied).

getAttributeLog.desc: Returns the attribute change log ({attributeChange, reason, time}).

getRewardDisplayName.desc: Returns the display translation key of an attribute: money, beamXP, vouchers, reputation, branch XP {txt, context} or the raw key.

getRecentFinancialChanges.desc: Recent financial history (the last 5 money changes by default), from most recent to oldest.

getFinancialHistory.desc: Money change history, from most recent to oldest.

getGameplayHistory.desc: Gameplay reward history (changes whose tags contain gameplay), with display names and icons.

getCareerHistoryInfo.desc: Returns the title (translation key) of the history screen: gameplay or financial (default).

onExtensionLoaded.desc: Hook: if the career is active, initializes the attributes then loads playerAttributes.json and attributeLog.json with compatibility conversions (returns false otherwise).

onCareerActive.desc: Hook: creates the <orgId>Reputation attribute (min/max from career_modules_reputation) for each organization that does not have one.

onSaveCurrentProfile.desc: Save hook: writes playerAttributes.json and attributeLog.json to <save>/career/.
